title: fix: the packet check reads inline sections and the marked plan
headline: The resume packet check keeps a section written on its label line and names the plan the Resume Point marks, so a new session no longer loses what waits on the owner.
alignment: v1.30.1 fixes the two gaps the 1.30.0 workbench verify found in the packet check; nothing else changes.

items.text: A section is the text on its label line and every line under it, up to a blank line, the next label or a heading. A pending list written on the label line came out empty, and the check then skipped the Active Plan.
items.where: What a new session sees waiting on the owner
items.before: Nothing, when the list sat on the label line

items.text: When the Resume Point names several files, the plan is the one its link text or a Plan: label marks; none marked means the full reading. The first link was taken before.
Write names any section a check would not find, and an empty label counts as not found.

verification: The new test fails on the 1.30.0 code at its first assertion: the pending list is empty.
A copy of the workbench's own tracking files, checked with the fixed script, shows the whole pending list and names the marked plan.

decisions.decision: Fixed now as 1.30.1, not in build 5
decisions.why: The gap is high: a session never saw what waits on the owner. A high never carries; the owner picked the fix now by pop-up.

decisions.decision: Several unmarked files mean the full reading
decisions.why: The check fails closed when it cannot tell; the Resume Point text still shows every link.

tests.flips: declared tests on main and on this branch; the PR run gives the final count
